## Problem

What user problem does this solve? Is the current behavior painful? Give an example.

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature you'd like. Include UI sketches or mockups if it helps.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you think about? Why is this one better?

## Scope

Which parts of the app does this touch? (popup / options / background / content / PDF renderer / cloud sync / Convex backend)

## Willing to contribute?

- [ ] I'm willing to open a PR
- [ ] I need help implementing this

## Additional context

Anything else — links, prior art, related issues.
